music-drums: A pencil drawing of an old drum machine with wooden ends, a grid of sixteen square pads, a row of knobs and a small blank screen, with two drumsticks crossed on the table in front.
music-decks: A pencil drawing of a turntable with a record on the platter and the tonearm resting on it, beside a small stack of plain record sleeves with one record sliding out.
science-waves: A pencil drawing of a small oscilloscope with a wave line on its screen, a tuning fork standing on a wooden sounding box beside it, and a coiled spring toy lying on the table.
word-foundry: A pencil drawing of a wooden printer's type tray with three big letter blocks carved A, B and C and rows of small plain type behind them, and a small anvil beside the tray.
